highlights.title: Less startup work and image memory
highlights.description: More modules load on demand when opening the app. Cover caches are bounded, and assistant images are stored at display size.

highlights.title: Less repeated work while reading and saving
highlights.description: Reading, annotations, and Reading Memory search do less repeated computation. Saving your reading position no longer rewrites the entire book body.

highlights.title: Keep your text selection
highlights.description: Web reader selections stay in place while annotations update, so you can continue copying or annotating.

highlights.title: Restore imports behind fake-IP proxies
highlights.description: Fixed web imports being rejected behind fake-IP proxies such as Clash and Surge. Private network articles can also be imported directly.

highlights.title: Back up before upgrading
highlights.description: This release migrates the database. v0.16.2 and earlier cannot open the upgraded data. To downgrade, restore a compatible backup made before upgrading.
